desc:
Can you imagine if Kogasa's actually an ojō-sama, and she has like a mansion and all that – from her blacksmithing craft, of course.

Huh... 🤨 I just read [**her entry in *WOoHS***](https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Whispered_Oracle_of_Hakurei_Shrine/Kogasa_Tatara). It seems ZUN has floated the idea that Kogasa might not actually be a karakasa, but a tatara (forge bellows) yōkai – specifically from the possible injuries to the eye and leg.

So I guess Kogasa is legit limping on one leg, and the blue eye is actually blind?
